title: Adaptive SMS and voice orchestration
acceptance_criteria: The trained engagement model selects channel/time from dated activity within consent, preference, quiet-hour, contact-limit and deadline constraints; readiness priority is a separate model output.
Explicit ride, call, symptom, or scheduling responses supersede prediction immediately and create the appropriate human-owned work without clinical interpretation.
Nonresponse or failure triggers rescoring with updated activity; explicit response or opt-out cancels superseded actions. No eligible action or unavailable model produces visible human follow-up.
The system never sends clinical advice, interprets symptoms, or closes a clinical barrier autonomously.
Provider-ready mode makes no Twilio or ElevenLabs network call and may create only internal planned or clearly disclosed replay events.
The UI never shows Delivered or Completed without a verified provider callback or clearly disclosed controlled replay.

Bounded live-test activation is authorized in OUTREACH-001 and requires protected credentials, verified contact allowlist, consent/opt-out, signed callbacks, idempotency, rate/budget limits and HIGH-risk dedicated security review before live acceptance.
The accessible composer and timeline cover empty, queued, scheduled, attempted, responded, opted-out, failed, and human-follow-up states without exposing a secret or arbitrary destination.

The backend persists and automatically dispatches due model-selected actions through the configured adapter without a second Send/Call click, recording decision, model version, feature cutoff, due time, mode and actual outcome.
Execution revalidates consent, kill switch, current appointment/response/plan and expiry; restart, duplicate ticks and retries do not produce duplicate logical attempts.

ML and OUTREACH acceptance prove learned selection plus automatic real SMS and voice delivery to the verified test phone; neither recommendations, hard-coded actions nor replay alone satisfy the requirement.
Twilio sends a real SMS and places an answered call playing the reviewed ElevenLabs audio; verified provider states and explicit inbound/keypad responses are recorded separately.
Live dispatch uses real wall-clock windows; reset/reseed or accelerated scenario time cannot resend or clear live dispatch history, opt-out, rolling limits or budget reservations.
Paid account availability is human-confirmed; sender registration/capability, API access, protected credentials, verified test contact, callbacks and voice asset must pass documented preflight.
